summary: All 8 acceptance criteria verified: 4 backend test files (6 tests) + 5 browser checks. All passed.

checks.name: auth-gate-blocks-unauthenticated
checks.evidence: Visiting / while logged out shows data-testid=auth-gate; briefing-view count is 0.

checks.name: wrong-passcode-rejected
checks.evidence: Submitting an incorrect passcode surfaces data-testid=passcode-error ('Incorrect passcode. Please try again.') and briefing-view stays absent. Console shows expected 401 from /api/auth/login.

checks.name: correct-passcode-unlocks-briefing
checks.evidence: Entering WVEdTalk-Desk-2026 unlocks and data-testid=briefing-view becomes visible.

checks.criterion: Lock returns to gate and persists
checks.name: lock-returns-to-gate-and-persists
checks.evidence: Clicking data-testid=lock-desk-button returns to auth-gate; page.reload() after lock keeps auth-gate visible and briefing-view absent.

checks.name: test_tscheck_protected_api_requires_auth.py
checks.evidence: GET /api/briefings (no auth) -> 401 {"detail":"Passcode required"}; GET /api/ -> 200. 2 tests passed.

checks.name: test_tscheck_removed_demo_endpoints.py
checks.evidence: GET /api/status -> 404 {"detail":"Not Found"}; POST /api/status -> 404. Confirmed absent from /openapi.json paths. 2 tests passed.

checks.name: test_tscheck_header_auth_works.py
checks.evidence: GET /api/briefings with header X-Desk-Passcode: WVEdTalk-Desk-2026 -> 200, list body with 2026-09-18 and 2026-09-19 briefings. 1 test passed.

checks.name: test_tscheck_settings_auto_lock_persists.py
checks.evidence: POST /api/settings/auto-lock {minutes:15} -> 200; GET /api/settings reflects auto_lock_minutes=15; original value (0) restored via same endpoint at test teardown. 1 test passed.

checks.name: settings-security-panel-autolock-persists
checks.evidence: On /settings, data-testid=security-panel shows change-passcode form (current/new/confirm inputs) and auto-lock-options (Off/5/15/30/60). Clicking auto-lock-5 highlights it and survives page reload (GET /api/settings backed). Restored to auto-lock-0 (Off) at end; passcode was NOT changed during this run so no restoration needed there. Final GET /api/settings confirms auto_lock_minutes=0.

notes: Passcode was never changed during testing (only auto-lock minutes, toggled and restored to 0/Off). No restoration action needed for APP_PASSCODE; verified still WVEdTalk-Desk-2026 by successful unlock in later checks.
8 acceptance criteria in briefing; 'Settings security controls work' produced both a backend and a browser artifact per the API-backed UI rule, yielding 9 total check entries.
